label: TP
reason: User input flows directly into the XPath expression without sanitization (L70), enabling injection. The resulting XML content is printed to the response (L82) without HTML encoding in the main execution path, whereas the ESAPI encoder is only applied in the exception handler (L84-86). The XXE protection setting (L55) does not mitigate XPath Injection vulnerabilities.

Unsanitized user input concatenated into XPath expression
